evidence_quotes:
Whether the vehicle is hard to start or runs rough or never develops full power,
it’s worth the few minutes that it takes to check the components of this system.
statements.reason: The text recommends checking the system when the vehicle never develops full power.
statements.statement: Failure to develop full engine power is a stated reason to check the air-intake/exhaust system.

evidence_quotes:
PROCEDURES: Visually inspect dust unloader for
presence and for cuts, tears,
obstructions, worn areas, enlarged
gap, or if center opening exceeds
1/8 in. (3.175 mm).
statements.reason: The stated threshold is 1/8 inch; 0.20 inch is greater than 0.125 inch.
statements.statement: A dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch (5.08 mm) exceeds the preventive maintenance check standard of 1/8 inch (3.175 mm).

evidence_quotes:
NOT FULLY MISSION CAPABLE IF: Dust unloader missing or
has cuts, tears, obstruc-
tions, worn areas,
enlarged gap, or if center
opening exceeds 1/8 in.
(3.175 mm).
statements.reason: A 0.20-inch opening exceeds the stated 1/8-inch not-fully-mission-capable threshold.
statements.statement: A dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch (5.08 mm) makes the unit not fully mission capable.
